stage: Completed supporting research for upgraded B and C composition; no model mutation
brief: Two dark/cool versions of the same complete usable room composition, with working wall, styled storage/light console and visitor/cat corner.
source_limit: These are original downloaded public Pin images, visually inspected. Creator authorship and image-production method are not independently verified. Their room geometry and furniture scale are not authoritative. No logged-in Pinterest feed was accessed.

current_model_intent.B: Five Black Ash panels form a 3.0 m wide feature across both working sections; Peppercorn wraps the rest of the work wall and window wall.
current_model_intent.C: Naval wraps the work wall and window wall; both variants share the same furniture and composed zones.
both: Retain the white ceiling, trim, original brick, owned white Honeywell lamp and natural cat tree.
The owned Mineral Aeron Size C is the primary working chair.
Keep two usable independent work surfaces: a primary standing desk and fixed IKEA project bench.
Group a 115 × 12 cm dark MOSSLANDA ledge, 100 × 70 cm Richmond print, small plant and books above the fixed bench.
An opal table lamp turns the folded-clothes chest into a styled storage console.
Place a medium floor palm by the visitor seat if its footprint passes the fit check; add a felt mat to the primary worktop.

composition_recommendation: Compose the desk wall as one continuous backdrop across both working sections. Place the shelf and art grouping above the fixed bench while preserving standing-monitor travel.
Repeat cool gray and black frames, stone textiles and restrained greenery across the working and visitor zones.
Use the closed clothes chest as a console: an opal lamp creates a visual anchor near the brick and visitor corner while its top remains usable.
Frame the visitor chair with the rug edge and a medium plant if its fit is verified; keep door approaches clear.
Keep overhead lighting bright for work while decorative light adds depth. Atmospheric reference exposure does not establish required working illumination.
selected_status: B and C remain the selected variants. This work adds room composition; no third color option.
